Lemma
[Average exponential quadratic decay] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0375, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0376 ↗ lem:chow-iii-rough-evolving-heat-kernel-upper-bound ↗ lem:chow-iii-weighted-l2-heat-estimate 1. ch26:26.23\group Heat Kernel Upper Bounds

If $\Ric _{g(0)}\ge -K$, then constants $C,D<\infty $ satisfy \[ \int _{\mathcal M}H^2(x,\tau ;y,v) e^{d_{g(0)}(x,y)^2/(D(\tau -v))}\, d\mu _{g(\tau )}(x) \le \frac{C}{\Vol _{g(0)}B_{g(0)}(y,\sqrt{\tau -v}/4)}, \] and the analogous estimate obtained by integrating in $y$ with measure $d\mu _{g(v)}$ and the volume centered at $x$.
Proof

\sketch Apply Lemma 2 to Dirichlet kernels on an exhaustion. The rough pointwise bound and the mass bound provide the unweighted $L^2$ hypothesis. Bishop–Gromov comparison makes the ball-volume function ((4,A))-regular. Pass to the exhaustion limit.

□
